summary: Regression after option A code review fixes (JWT_SECRET fallback removal, hardcoded test passwords removed, hook deps changes). Backend: 21/21 pytest passed using env-var driven credentials. Frontend: login + Schedule (with Period Times tab), Students, Teachers, Messages, Subjects all load with zero console errors. Production readiness improved.
passed_tests: Backend: super_admin and school_admin login (env-driven creds)
Backend: /api/auth/me, dashboards, subjects/exams CRUD, schedule sections, reports, settings, activity, messages (list/unread/send), grades
Frontend: Schedule page renders weekly grid + Period Times tab ('أوقات الحصص') visible
Frontend: Students, Teachers, Messages, Subjects pages load without console errors
Frontend: No console/pageerror events during navigation across all critical pages

code_review_verifications.jwt_secret_fallback_removed: Confirmed - server.py line 26 uses os.environ['JWT_SECRET']; backend starts and /api/health returns 200, meaning JWT_SECRET is present in backend/.env
code_review_verifications.hardcoded_test_passwords_removed: Confirmed - test_school_management.py lines 12-15 now read SMS_TEST_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD and SMS_TEST_SCHOOL_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD from env. No 'Admin@123' literal in test file.
code_review_verifications.language_context_false_positives: Not directly reviewed in this iteration; main agent documented in /app/docs/SECURITY_REVIEW.md per request
code_review_verifications.hook_dependency_fixes: SchedulePage/StudentsPage/TeachersPage/MessagesPage/AuthCallback all navigate and render correctly with no console warnings observed

critical_code_review_comments: CORS: server.py uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False but auth route sets httpOnly session cookies with samesite='none'; cookies will not be sent cross-origin without credentials. Cookie path works because frontend and backend share host. Acceptable for current deployment but should be revisited when localStorage auth is migrated.
Auth still stores JWT in localStorage (intentionally not changed per user request) - documented in SECURITY_REVIEW.md as known risk. XSS would expose token.
JWT_SECRET value in backend/.env is a static string committed-like default; for production it should be rotated to a strong random secret via secret manager.
Schedule endpoint /api/schedule/ without section_id returns 404 instead of 422; minor REST hygiene issue only.
routes_extended.py size not refactored (per user request); long-term maintainability concern.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all targeted pages load, zero console errors)

production_readiness_score.rationale: Backend APIs stable, auth working, JWT_SECRET hardcoded fallback removed, test secrets externalized, hook dependency warnings addressed for critical pages. Remaining gaps: (1) JWT stored in localStorage (XSS risk, intentionally deferred), (2) static JWT_SECRET committed in .env (rotate before prod), (3) routes_extended.py monolith pending refactor, (4) CORS allow_origins='*' should be tightened in production.

seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed subject/exam/message created during pytest run; safe to ignore or cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest now requires env vars SMS_TEST_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD and SMS_TEST_SCHOOL_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD plus REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Set them before running pytest. JWT_SECRET is mandatory in backend/.env (no fallback). All option-A code-review fixes verified successful.
